notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE - JULY25
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a few months since we released [i]PSYCHExFUSE DEMO[/i] and we're really happy with how much you all loved it! [/p][p][/p][p]We thought we'd let you know that development for the second half of Part 1 (dubbed Part 1:2) is very much underway and our radio silence is us just working very hard! (please believe us). We've got lots in store for you; juicier story bits, more dynamic locations, new threats, and loads of visual & gameplay improvements to what is already available to play in [i]PSYCHExFUSE DEMO[/i] - we can't wait to see what you all think! [/p][p][/p][h3]An official release date announcement will come soon, most likely around [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2025. [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Until then, use this doodle from our concept artist to tide you over.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/3775eb7f0a1a5562c45c9b47d092bcd7e3d70395.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Don't forget to wishlist! [/h3][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p][/p][p][b]MIZAEL[/b][/p][p]SWD & Team MoF Club[/p][p][url="https://sewingwithdaydreams.com/"]https://sewingwithdaydreams.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://discord.gg/RWpEEpcZXH"]PSYCHExFUSE LINK TERMINAL[/url] (Discord)[/h3]

notes.title: Play the PSYCHExFUSE DEMO today!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're pleased to announce that the [i]PSYCHExFUSE DEMO[/i] is now available in time for The Storyteller's Festival 2025! Thank you to the hosts at Two and a Half Studios for having us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/1fc70d1670df3db5a64401e4a75e85a419799971.png[/img]
The DEMO covers the first half of [i]Part 1: L.C.D[/i], the rest of which will be releasing some time later this year in Early Access.

Here's a sneak peak of a major area in Part 1, the Main Plexus! Seems something happened there and now it's a bit of a gloomy mess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/b9a84adfef5b9042dc5778eef4e6082c3aafd017.png[/img]
We also now have a Discord server - the [url=https://discord.gg/RWpEEpcZXH]PSYCHExFUSE LINK TERMINAL[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/769d18ec6d00f91b96a56ba86b2777487ea096d1.png[/img]
If you have any feedback or bugs to report - or just want to talk about the game - that's the place! 

It's been around a year since we begun work on this project, and we're in disbelief that we actually have something out there! We of course couldn't have done it without all the wonderful support from our family & friends (special shoutout to those who played the prototype with MS Paint maps!)

I think that's about all we have to say for now, we'll hand over to the mysterious voice who can't seem to work a basic piece of technology!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/e3739b2fd2a781952d14a720548d5885f8d1b84e.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy!
Mizael, ChocolateBananaFanta & Cheerio
[url=https://sewingwithdaydreams.com/]https://sewingwithdaydreams.com/[/url]

notes.title: PSYCHExFUSE is on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

As our first post on Steam, we thought we'd let you know that the [i]PSYCHExFUSE DEMO[/i] is not far away! 

We'll be making a specific announcement for it on all socials channels soon - but for the dedicated few who already have followed and wishlisted us on Steam, here's a little trivia for you...

[i]PSYCHExFUSE[/i] has been in active development for around 6 months, and had been in the planning and concept stage for another 4 months prior. It started as a love letter to the RPGMaker Horror titles of the early 2010's like [i]The Crooked Man[/i], [i]Ib [/i]and [i]The Witch's House[/i], but as time went on it grew into its own unique adventure which is what you see on display today!

While you wait, here's a teaser from an area you'll be exploring in the DEMO - a once magical garden ravaged by toxic LCD liquid... We hope you like mushrooms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/99576fa7dd86475a851095260028d713fa33efbd.png[/img]

We'll be updating a little more actively from now on, so stay tuned for more from us at [i]Sewing with Daydreams![/i]

If you haven't already, please wishlist and follow all of our socials!
